evidence: 92 previously fixed anchor questions only; missing answers ignored
primary_test_metric: Mean negative log likelihood over the three reserved questions
secondary_metrics: Mean total variation distance of answer shares
comparators: Same model with zero respondent vector
selection_policy: Use the existing selected model unchanged; no further calibration or selection after seeing final labels.
prediction_seal: Save all final/novel probabilities and their SHA256 before loading final-test answers.
simulation: One independent categorical answer per persona per question using the fixed seed. Use mean probabilities for headline survey shares.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap of people on three fixed test questions; no claim about uncertainty across questions or model selection. No real-world confidence bands for novel predictions.
limitations: Historical U.S. Prolific sample, not population weighted or a forecast.
Public-data model pretraining contamination cannot be ruled out.
Related policy items share the same instrument; the three questions are not three independent domains.
Novel survey ratings have no human ground truth and cannot establish accuracy.
